(a) A fixed inclined ladder shall be provided where the top of the buffer cylinder is over 1 524 mm (5 ft.) in height above the pit floor.

(b) A fixed vertical or inclined ladder fitted with an inspection and maintenance platform with guard rails shall be provided where the top of the car buffer cylinder is over 2 134 mm (7 ft.) from the pit floor.
